title: IslamApp: Prayer times & Athan
description:
IslamApp has been embraced by over 1 million Muslims worldwide.

Why IslamApp:
• Free with NO Ads
• Accurate Prayer Times (""اوقات الصلاة"")
• Sunnah Prayers: Tahajjud and Duha
• Athan: Prayer Reminder
• Qibla Compass
• Holy Quran
• Handy Widgets
• Islamic Calendar and Special Days
• Ramadan Fasting Schedule

🕌 Accurate Prayer Times
IslamApp utilizes new technologies that make namaz (salah) times more precise, even without the internet. It uses mosque times where possible. In the settings, you can add Sunnah prayers such as Tahajjud and Duha. Get the schedule for the month and year. The schedule is adapted for social networks, allowing you to share it with friends and family in a couple of clicks.

🔔 Azan: Reminder for the beginning of Salah (salat)
Never miss a prayer with IslamApp. A vibrant sound wakes you for Fajr. Tailor notifications with your preferred athan or system sounds.

📖 Holy Quran
Read, listen, and comprehend the Holy Quran. IslamApp offers access to diverse reciters, along with meaningful translations and tafsir. Reflecting on the Quran's verses is a duty for every Muslim!

🕋 Qibla Compass
Discover the direction to the Holy Kaaba with our qibla finder. No concerns about accuracy; receive alerts for low accuracy or interference.

⭐️ Free with NO Ads
Your peace of mind is our top priority. Completely ad-free to ensure nothing distracts you.

⭐️ Handy Widgets
Stay focused. Check prayer times directly from your home screen with our user-friendly widgets.

📅 Islamic Calendar
Guiding you on your spiritual journey with the Hijra (Hijri) calendar.

🎉 Special Days
Celebrate special days with IslamApp. Easily share with friends and family.

⭐️ Ramadan Fasting Time (Sawm/Uraza)
Effortlessly embrace fasting during the sacred month of Ramadan! Seamlessly obtain the Iftar and Suhur times for each month with the convenience of IslamApp.

With heartfelt regards,
The IslamApp Team
